# netbox_l2vpn_termination (Data Source)

Retrieves a single l2vpn termination from NetBox. The lookup fails if no match or more than one match is found.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netbox_l2vpn_termination" "example" {
  id       = 1
  l2vpn_id = 1
}

output "l2vpn_termination_id" {
  value = data.netbox_l2vpn_termination.example.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `assigned_object_type` (String) The assigned object type of the l2vpn termination.
- `id` (Number) The numeric ID of the l2vpn termination.
- `l2vpn_id` (Number) The ID of the l2vpn associated with the l2vpn termination.

### Read-Only

- `assigned_object` (String) The assigned object of the l2vpn termination.
- `assigned_object_id` (Number) The assigned object id of the l2vpn termination.
- `created` (String) The created of the l2vpn termination.
- `custom_fields` (Map of String) Custom field values of the l2vpn termination, as a map of field name to value.
- `last_updated` (String) The last updated of the l2vpn termination.
- `tags` (Set of String) Tags assigned to the object, by name.
